gatesBeforeTiming: compiled A07 with strict reader and negative canaries
controls: identical exact requests/all hypotheses/full proof/physical admission/work/cache isolation
earlyStop: Stop remaining pairs if correctness fails or initial paired candidate cold/proof timing provides no useful gain; retain failure and NOT RUN rows.
acceptance: Require useful repeatable paired improvement beyond observed within-variant variation; no threshold/deadline/proof change. All timings remain private measurements, never normal acceptance.
